author: LowNSlow
quote: GTA with limitation. Simp/cuck simulator. Heat system ****, gets tiring. Story is all over the place and none of the characters are likeable. If you are a Christian you should not play. Radio stations mock Christians and God. There is also a mission required to get a trophy where you sacrifice a human to a satanic ritual. You also can’t steal neighbors cars, run over protesters or many other things compared to other GTAs. Psyop type game very brainwashing 0/10
